recA5BnM5umys9yRk.Body: Kyle and Serena Denton are community herbalists creating wild-crafted and organic plant medicines out of Milwaukee since 2015. I have used their teas and tinctures on an almost daily basis for years now. Kyle is a great friend of InnerVerse and has appeared on the channel more times than I can count. These products work—not in the allopathic "pharma-medicine" way, but in a terrain-support, consciousness bolstering plant-teacher sort of way.
recA5BnM5umys9yRk.Name: Tippecanoe Herbs

recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.
recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Name: The Sonic Slider

recFdBmTf1pJJOP6S.Body: LotusWei provides amazing and transformative plant essence elixirs, using one of nature's most gentle and beautiful elements—the flowers themselves. Led by founder Katie Hess, LotusWei supports customers with diverse products that operate on homeopathic principles and energetic resonances. I use LotusWei Elixirs to give me an edge with psychic & energetic sensitivity, discernment, and life force coherence. In other words, LotusWei Elixirs help me be a better podcaster and Biofield Tuner. Benefits accumulate over long term use!
recFdBmTf1pJJOP6S.Name: LotusWei Flower Elixirs

recMVdJjP2VZJyI2m.Body: Clive de Carle has spent decades researching high-quality natural health essentials, from magnesium and fulvic minerals to iodine, selenium, and vegan-sourced vitamin D. His supplements are formulated with a focus on bioavailability, so the body can actually absorb and use what you're taking rather than letting it pass through unused. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.
recMVdJjP2VZJyI2m.Name: Clive de Carle

rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Bio: Chance Garton is the host and producer of the Innerverse Podcast, where for over a decade he has investigated consciousness, mythology, symbolism, terrain health, and the psychosomatic language of the human body and mind. A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Name: Chance Garton
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Role: Host of the Innerverse Podcast, biofield tuning practitioner & researcher

rec99SfHWCs28gW2p.Bio: Yerasimos Stilianessis is a transformational bodywork coach who incorporates the Human Design system into his practice, focusing on touch, somatic healing, and psycho-somatic health.
rec99SfHWCs28gW2p.Name: Yerasimos Stilianessis

recoE8D0vEV0CtFdv.Bio: Sophie Fletcher, PhD, blends Human Design with somatic psychology to help people understand their unique energetic makeup and integrate embodied approaches to spiritual development; she appeared on InnerVerse to introduce the basics of Human Design and somatic practice.
recoE8D0vEV0CtFdv.Name: Sophie Fletcher
recoE8D0vEV0CtFdv.Role: Human Design practitioner and somatic psychologist

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Human design as an experiment, not a belief system", "body": "Answering Liam in the chat, Sophie Fletcher points newcomers to jovianarchive.com and the source material from Ra Uru Hu, who she says downloaded the system, plus The Definitive Book of Human Design by Ra and Lynda Bunnell. She describes backtracking in her own training after two teachers whose interpretations had skewed the foundations. Yerasimos Stilianessis offers PDFs of Ra's early nineties white book and black book, recommends Human Design: The Science of Differentiation, and insists the system is a tool rather than a bible. Sophie relays Ra's own framing that it is an experiment: try it, and throw it out if it does not work."}, {"title": "The five types, and why Sophie stopped chasing generator energy", "body": "Sophie Fletcher lays out the five types in human design, generators, manifesting generators, manifestors, projectors and reflectors, and says roughly seventy percent of people carry generator or manifesting generator energy through a defined sacral center. As a projector she describes deconditioning from that Energizer Bunny pressure, learning that naps are allowed, and needing to go horizontal after big gatherings like Confluence and Music and Sky. Her strategy, she says, is to wait for the invitation rather than initiate, with a penetrative aura that reads the other person. Chance Garton offers his herbalist friend Kyle at Tepic New Herbs as a live example of an invitation arriving before it was sent."}, {"title": "Reading Chance's chart on air, from neutrinos to Wilhelm Reich", "body": "Using Chance Garton's own chart as the worked example, Sophie Fletcher explains the two columns: the black personality side imprinted at birth, and the red design side that comes online about eighty eight days earlier, which she attributes to neutrinos carrying and dropping off information. Numbers before the decimal map to I Ching hexagrams, numbers after to profile lines. Yerasimos Stilianessis reads notes on Chance's incarnation cross, the left angle cross of healing, which he says Chance shares with Wilhelm Reich, describing a purpose of bringing healing to others and a warning about becoming depleted by taking on their conditions."}, {"title": "The 2027 shift into the Cross of the Sleeping Phoenix", "body": "Asked by Rand about the coming age change, Sophie Fletcher explains that the collective is moving out of the Cross of Planning, her own incarnation cross, and into the Cross of the Sleeping Phoenix, on a cycle she and Yerasimos Stilianessis put at roughly four hundred years. She frames it as a mutation in the solar plexus, which she calls the youngest and most immature center, shifting culture from tribal self sacrifice, the greater good rallying cry of recent years, toward individuality held inside the group. She stresses that much of this is speculation and that none of us yet know how it will land."}, {"title": "Titration, trauma and the practice of energetic hygiene", "body": "Sophie Fletcher describes her somatic approach to survival energy locked in the body, working slowly so the system is not blown past its window of tolerance, titrating in and out of what she calls the trauma vortex and counter vortex, and reorienting a client to the moment they realized they would live. Her doctoral work, she says, examined the interrelational dynamics of physical contact between bodyworkers and clients. For psychic vampirism she asks the question is this mine, and names running water, trees and showers. Chance Garton adds Joel H. Slate's Psychic Vampires and Cindy Dale's Energetic Boundaries as reading, describing tells he claims mark an energy drain."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Sophie Fletcher returns to pick up where we left off in our recent InnerVerse episode covering the basics of Human Design. Joining us is her partner-in-life Yerasimos Stilianessis of Here For The Truth Podcast. With the deep experience and knowledge of somatic psychology and related philosophies that these two possess, you'll want to tune in live to chime in with your questions!
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "Why am I hitting my head against a brick wall trying to change this person because I think that they should be like me, versus just accepting that he's doing what's right for him?", "author": "Sophie Fletcher", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cc5dc5bb-2848-4359-9f0a-463178622b47/SOPHIE-FLETCHER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Building capacity within your nervous system and being able to hold space for discomfort and not just acting out from conditioned responses goes a long way in partnership and communication.", "author": "Yerasimos Stilianessis", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e59decf-e436-4562-a3bd-b7d0cbe70fec/YERASIMOS-STILIANESSIS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "So being a projector, sort of getting in tune with what's my natural energy level: I don't have to keep up with the generators in my life.", "author": "Sophie Fletcher", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cc5dc5bb-2848-4359-9f0a-463178622b47/SOPHIE-FLETCHER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "So don't make decisions when you're at the height of a wave or the low of the wave, and so give yourself time for major decisions to get data points along the way.", "author": "Yerasimos Stilianessis", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e59decf-e436-4562-a3bd-b7d0cbe70fec/YERASIMOS-STILIANESSIS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I consider even the biofield anatomy could potentially be imaginary, not that that makes it not real, but that it's a language.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Ra talks about how it's an experiment, so play with it, try it, see if it works for you. If it doesn't, throw it out.", "author": "Sophie Fletcher", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cc5dc5bb-2848-4359-9f0a-463178622b47/SOPHIE-FLETCHER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The more symbolic literacy we have, we can actually see that every dang thing is synchronicity in every moment.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The solar plexus, that emotional center, is the youngest center, it's the most immature center that we have so far, and it's going through this massive mutation.", "author": "Sophie Fletcher", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cc5dc5bb-2848-4359-9f0a-463178622b47/SOPHIE-FLETCHER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "We're social beings, there are going to be communities, but we're moving to a more individualistic age, not this collectivistic age where we need to sacrifice who we are for some collective or family or group.", "author": "Yerasimos Stilianessis", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e59decf-e436-4562-a3bd-b7d0cbe70fec/YERASIMOS-STILIANESSIS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "If you can find the universal truth in something that you're investigating, you found the seeds of value within it.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I don't think that we're supposed to be these sort of walled off, complete isolated beings. We are porous, we are energetically interacting with those around us in the world.", "author": "Sophie Fletcher", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cc5dc5bb-2848-4359-9f0a-463178622b47/SOPHIE-FLETCHER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "This is what I love about individuality: we're doing our thing, each one of us, we're adding a piece of the puzzle, and we're being ourselves as best as we can.", "author": "Yerasimos Stilianessis", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/4e59decf-e436-4562-a3bd-b7d0cbe70fec/YERASIMOS-STILIANESSIS.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
